claims.behavior: Add the exact per-service already-exist-test filter action. Capture the service key, open the shared three-tab tag-filter editor with the exact reference explanation and configured parser namespaces, and enable the test when its filter is accepted. The accepted filter updates only the importer draft; child Cancel preserves filter/toggle, parent Apply waits, and owner Cancel/close retires the child and retained callbacks. Saved queue options preserve the selected filter; the real file importer tests only admitted parsed/additional tags against current mappings on the selected service, while excluded tags and disabled gates bypass the test.
limits: Authored Rust model/native/file-importer regressions await hosted CI. No local Cargo build, Rust test or mutation run.
Native presents the existing-tag action directly on the service panel rather than in the reference cog menu, and uses its existing owned detached filter window rather than a Qt modal dialog.

This claim covers one original missing action and its saved consumer; broader per-service/import-option editor parents remain Partial. Existing shared tag-filter language/favourites are reused and are not new completions.
